content: Airbnb identity verification: host-visible states are pending (hours to 24-48h), verified, and failed. Failure causes are enumerated publicly (name mismatch with profile, poor document photo, expired document, inconsistent account details, additional review required) but the in-product failure message is frequently vague, and community/legal-advice posts tell hosts to screenshot the exact wording and ask support what failed. The dominant complaint is an opaque terminal 'failed' with no named cause and no stated retry path.
